title: Nature of Discrimination in Cases that Breached Tripartite Guidelines on Fair Employment Practices
what_it_is: Nature of Discrimination in Cases that Breached Tripartite Guidelines on Fair Employment Practices

sections.label: TAFEP discrimination cases and penalties
sections.summary: TAFEP handled about 400 discrimination cases yearly, with about 50 employers breaching guidelines and having work pass privileges suspended.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Over the past three years, the Tripartite Alliance for Fair and Progressive Employment Practices (TAFEP) handled an average of 400 discrimination cases annually, including those arising from proactive checks by the Ministry of Manpower (MOM) on discriminatory hiring practices.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In about 50 cases each year, the employers were found to be in breach of the Tripartite Guidelines on Fair Employment Practices and had their work pass privileges suspended.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: About 60% of such cases involved nationality-based discrimination, and about one-third involved gender and age discrimination, split about equally between the two.

sections.label: MOM warnings and repeat offenders
sections.summary: MOM issued an average of 40 warnings annually, and there has been no repeat offender over the past three years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM issued an average of 40 warnings annually.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Over the past three years, there has not been a repeat offender.

sections.label: Perceived discrimination among local jobseekers
sections.summary: MOM observed an increase in the percentage of local jobseekers who perceived discrimination during the job search between 2014 and 2018.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Notwithstanding the progress made by employers over the years, MOM did observe an increase in the percentage of local jobseekers who perceived discrimination during the job search process between 2014 and 2018.

sections.label: Reviewing penalty framework for discrimination
sections.summary: The penalty framework was reviewed in 2020 and will be reviewed further if necessary, with no repeat discriminatory practices seen from penalised companies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I know the Minister of State shared some of the other penalties earlier, but I am just wondering overall, we can review the penalty framework so that it is aligned with what the discrimination is about.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: We just reviewed the penalty framework in 2020 and we will continue to review it further if necessary.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Thus far, we have not seen any repeat of discriminatory practices from the companies that were penalised.
